name: Blighted Physiology
body:
Drawbacks
Blighted Physiology
Source People of the River pg. 7
Category Region
Requirement(s) Numeria
Exposure to the corruption that seeps through every drop of water and grain of dirt in Numeria has altered your body. Horrific growths beneath your skin provide you a +1 natural armor bonus to AC, but your body does not work as a normal creature’s would. You become sickened for 1 round anytime you receive magical healing.
